0022600222.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, 1-5 at home, 15th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (10-2, 1st in the West), with Milwaukee on a seven-game losing streak and Los Angeles on a six-game winning streak. Tyler Herro is day-to-day with a knee bruise and is a game-time decision for the Bucks, where he is averaging 21.4 points in 30.7 minutes per game, while Quentin Grimes is day-to-day with a finger injury and is also a game-time decision for the Lakers. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the Bucks' most recent meeting a 105-101 win in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
